report.headline: Highest reported QLD1 operational demand was 5693.0 MW at 2025-10-05 00:30 AEST (interval_end_utc 2025-10-04T14:30:00Z).
summary: The highest operational demand present in the returned QLD1 operational-demand series is 5693.0 MW at 2025-10-05 00:30 AEST (interval_end_utc 2025-10-04T14:30:00Z) [ev0001].
AEMO definitions note that actual operational demand includes the measured operational demand reconstituted with estimated actual Wholesale Demand Response (WDR) [c1].
Not all half-hour intervals for the local day were available at the as_of timestamp, so the value above is the maximum of the intervals returned and may not be the full local-day peak.
No operational-demand forecasts for QLD1 covering 2025-10-04T20:00:00Z..2025-10-05T08:00:00Z were returned in the snapshot, and no forecast-vs-actual MAE is available as of 2025-10-05T02:00:00Z.

possible_explanations.statement: The reported operational-demand value might reflect the reconstituted actual operational demand that includes estimated Wholesale Demand Response, per AEMO definitions [c1].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the measured operational demand and the reconstituted operational demand (and the WDR field) in the AEMO operational-demand CSV for the same interval to see the WDR component.

possible_explanations.statement: This observed maximum might not be the full local-day peak because several half-hour intervals were not yet available at the as_of time.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Rerun the operational-demand query with a later as_of_utc (after 2025-10-05T02:00:00Z) to retrieve the missing half-hour intervals and check the window maximum.
